theta.p: [Thita+ṇa.(stheṭa-saṃ)] (ti) CL=7 (1) True (or) Right. (2) Firm and steadfast, It is not changing for the worse. (3) One who is being honest, (40 Theta-saddā. See - Thirapariyāya. Theta(ti) [theta+ṇa] (1) One who is trustworthy. See also - Theta-(1). (2) One who used to speak true words (means who is honest). See also - Thirakatha.

H: theta：a．[cf．tiṭṭhita，Sk．sthātṛ] 確固的，真實的，能（可）信頼的，正直的，永住者．abl．thetato 實際上（in truth），（表示資格立場身份等）作為永住者，當作永住者．
S: theta：a．[cf．tiṭṭhita，Sk．sthātṛ] 確固の，真実の，信頼すベき，正直の，永住者．abl．thetato 実際に，永住者として．
D: Theta，【形】 可靠的，可信赖的。（p151）

[< *sthavita, pp of √sthū? cf S. stheṣṭha?], firm; trustworthy; sure, certain ; D I 4, 14 (musāvādā paṭivirato samaṇo Gotamo saccavādī saccasandho ~o paccayiko, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ṭheto; Sv 73, 17 : ~o ti thiro thirakatho ti attho, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ṭhitakatho ti); M I 8, 17 (atthi me attā ti vā ’ssa saccato ~ato diṭṭhi uppajjati; Ps I 70, 22 : bhūtato ca thirato ca); S IV 384, 7 (diṭṭhe va dhamme saccato ~ato tathāgate anupalabbhiyamāne); Kv 68, 8 (ekacco satthā diṭṭhe va dhamme attānaṃ saccato ~ato paññāpeti); Ps II 207, 1 (asinā sīse chijjante pi dve kathā na katheti ayaṃ vuccati ~o); — see also thāvara, thira.
